name: diamonds
description: You see a large pile of gleaming diamonds here!

name: axe
description: You see a standard Marcos axe here.

name: bottle
description: There is a bottle with a strange potion inside of it here! It has a label stuck to it that you could READ.

name: sword
description: There is a poor quality Marcos sword here.

name: sack of coins
description: You find a sack with 50 gold coins inside!

name: ring
description: As the Mimic dies, it rolls over and you find an unmarked gold ring! It tingles with a faint magical aura.

name: mace
description: There is a high quality Marcos mace here.

name: spices
description: You find several spices. They are of a rare variety and quite valuable.

name: book
description: There is an old book here. It glows in the darkness and is remarkably well preserved.
read_text: As you read the book, you feel a weird sensation overtaking you. You are turning into a small fish!

name: TrollsFire
description: The Pirate was carrying a beautiful sword. Carved on the hilt, in intricate detail, is the sword's name, "TrollsFire".

name: jewels
description: There is a large pile of jewels here!

name: chest
description: There is a large chest in the center of the room.

name: empty bottle
description: The healing potion is now empty.

name: a secret passage east
description: You've found a hidden tunnel going off to the east!

name: salt water
description: The water tastes salty, but doesn't appear to be poisonous.

name: dead rat
description: You see the hacked up body of what was once a huge rat.

name: Priest's body
description: The Priest's corpse lies on the floor, his face frozen in a fanatic's sneer.

name: Cynthia's body
description: Cynthia's body lies sprawled here, a pitiful sight.

name: Hermit's body
description: You see the hermit's smelly body lying crumpled on the floor.

name: dead gorilla
description: You see the shaggy corpse of a dead gorilla.

name: Heinrich's body
description: Heinrich's broken body lies on the floor here. You can still picture that sticker saying, "Hi, I'm Heinrich!"

name: dead Mimic
description: The dead Mimic lies in a formless blob on the floor.

name: Pirate's body
description: The body of the Pirate, his fine-looking clothing now slashed and bloody, lies here.

name: boat
description: This must be the boat the pirate used to travel to and from the cove from his ship. It currently has a large hole in it and is quite useless.

name: inscription
description: You see an inscription on the wall which reads, "You can type GET ALL to pick up everything in the room. This will usually not pick up dead bodies or immovable objects like doors and inscriptions."
read_text: You can type GET ALL to pick up everything in the room. This will usually not pick up dead bodies or immovable objects like doors and inscriptions.

name: inscription
description: An inscription on the wall reads, "The instructions often show commands in all caps for emphasis, but commands are not case sensitive."
read_text: The instructions often show commands in all caps for emphasis, but commands are not case sensitive.

name: inscription
description: Written on the wall are the words, "Most commands can be abbreviated. For example, AT DR is the same as ATTACK DRAGON, and DR PO is the same as DRINK POTION."
read_text: Most commands can be abbreviated. For example, AT DR is the same as ATTACK DRAGON, and DR PO is the same as DRINK POTION.

name: writing
description: You see some words chiseled into the wall: "To repeat the last command, just hit the Enter key again. To recall previous commands, use the up and down arrow keys."
read_text: To repeat the last command, just hit the Enter key again. To recall previous commands, use the up and down arrow keys.

name: inscription
description: There are some words written here: "Interesting items are sometimes hidden (embedded) within the description of the room. For example, try looking at the boat in the bay. You can also find secret doors by looking at unusual features in the room, like rough walls, cracks, bookshelves, etc."
read_text: Interesting items are sometimes hidden (embedded) within the description of the room. For example, try looking at the boat in the bay. You can also find secret doors by looking at unusual features in the room, like rough walls, cracks, bookshelves, etc.

name: writing
description: You see some words carved into the wall: "You may change weapons by using the READY command, e.g., READY SWORD. You may wear armor and shields using the WEAR command (e.g., WEAR CHAIN MAIL) and take them off with the REMOVE command."
read_text: You may change weapons by using the READY command, e.g., READY SWORD. You may wear armor and shields using the WEAR command (e.g., WEAR CHAIN MAIL) and take them off with the REMOVE command.
